name: When should I consider professional power washing for my home's exterior?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider professional power washing for my home's exterior?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional power washing is recommended when you notice dirt, grime, mold, mildew, or other stains accumulating on your home's siding, driveway, deck, or patio. These substances can not only detract from your home's appearance but can also cause long-term damage if left untreated. Generally, power washing every 1-2 years helps maintain cleanliness and prevents buildup. It's an effective way to restore your home's curb appeal and prepare surfaces for repainting or sealing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider professional power washing every 1-2 years when you see dirt, mold, or stains on your home's exterior to maintain appearance and prevent damage.
